title: HtmlImg
responsibility: Renders the native img element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlImg.children
inputs.description: Optional child snippet accepted for native-element API compatibility; this void element renders no child content. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (no child snippet).

outputs.name: HtmlImg
outputs.description: The actual native img element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper. States: alt-only: The source is omitted and the browser displays the supplied No image available alternative text.

errors.name: Caller content or event error
errors.description: Supplied event handlers and rendered child snippets may throw; the atom does not catch their errors. Void elements ignore the child snippet.
